series.name: Valentine's Day
series.desc: A short February event full of hearts: limited collectibles, unboxable exotics and a limited Valentine's upgrader. Recent years added Valentino's quest.

series.name: St. Patrick's Day
series.desc: Started in 2017 with The Leprechaun, whose Clover-Tron 400 only takes Golden Clovers. Later years have you hunt the map for Magic Clovers, and the Golden Clover Blaster often comes back.

series.name: Spring
series.desc: Seasonal refreshes as winter ends. Spring 2021 swapped the snowy map for a vibrant one, and the 2016 Outdoors Update brought spring exotics like Excalibur.

series.name: Easter
series.desc: Egg hunts around The Haven and Easter Island, Easter Boxes and Eggxotics. Find eggs to earn rewards and limited Easter items.

series.name: Anniversary
series.desc: Miner's Haven came out on June 12, 2015. Each birthday brings Birthday Boxes, cake-themed items and limited crafts. There was no party in 2019 while the game was on hiatus.

series.name: Summer
series.desc: Big mid-year updates with summer maps: the 2015 Summer Update, Fourth of July 2016, the 2017 Summer Update that brought back PvP, and 2018's Gargantuan Update.

series.name: Halloween
series.desc: The very first limited-time event (2015). Make Candy, spend it at Lucian's Spooky Shop, and trade for Pirate Santa's presents. Pumpkin Boxes return, and 2020 to 2022 had the Four Horsemen quest.

series.name: Black Friday
series.desc: Late November. The first ones sold one-day artifacts with secret perks; since 2018 it's been a sale on gamepasses.

series.name: Winter & New Year
series.desc: December brings snow, Festive Boxes and Santa. Make gifts with snowflake-marked items and trade them for presents that unwrap into items. New Year's countdowns close out the year.

series.name: Specials & milestones
series.desc: One-off events: Exotic Day, the Clan Contest, Roblox's Innovation and Pizza Party events, and celebrations for 100 million visits and 1 million favorites.

events.name: Halloween 2026
events.summary: Halloween has arrived in Miner's Haven! Treat yourselves this year with previously obtainable gifts from Pirate Santa! This is a rerun of last year event.

events.name: 11th Birthday
events.summary: Miner's Haven has reached eleven years old! Along with it is a rerun of last year's event with new and exciting rewards!

events.name: Easter 2026
events.summary: Easter has returned once again to Miner's Haven! with 14 new Limited Shiny! Along with the egg collection event. This event does not featured any Eggs, however you can obtain The Egg Portal from Fallen Eggs or Easter Box!

events.name: St. Patrick's Day 2026
events.summary: St. Patrick's Day has arrived in Miner's Haven! Find yourself scavenging through the map for Magic Clovers to earn yourself a reward. This event features 2 new items, the elusive Golden Clover Blaster has also returned for the duration of the event.

events.name: Winter 2025
events.summary: As per usual and previous events, you'll be producing gifts for Santa with special event items. In exchange, you'll receive rare presents that will unwrap into items! Jak'uhfdor will give you the essentials, she can be found over by the giant Christmas tree with Santa.

events.name: Black Friday 2025
events.summary: The tenth annual Black Friday sale to Miner's Haven began on November 29 2025 at 12:00 AM UTC and Ends on December 2 2025 at 12:00 AM UTC

events.name: Halloween 2025
events.summary: Halloween has arrived in Miner's Haven! Treat yourselves with 2 brand new gift in Pirate Santa! Along with various changes and balance to candy making.

events.name: 10th Birthday
events.summary: On 30 August, 2025, the Miner's Haven Tenth Anniversary Update commemorated the first decade of Miner's Haven (2015–2025). With it came along with many new items, item rebalances, and much more!

events.name: Valentine's Day 2025
events.summary: Valentine's Day has arrive in Miner's Haven! Obtain the newly added Eros Elixir from Valentino's quest, along with various limited time items!

events.name: Winter 2024
events.summary: As per usual and previous events, you'll be producing gifts for Santa with special event items. In exchange, you'll receive rare presents that will unwrap into items! Jak'uhfdor will give you the essentials, she can be found over by the giant Christmas tree with Santa.

events.name: Halloween 2024
events.summary: Halloween has arrived in Miner's Haven! This year's event is a rerun, make candy from various items obtained from Lucian and trade them in for Presents sold by Pirate Santa!

events.name: 9th Birthday
events.summary: Miner's Haven just turned nine this year! Celebrate nine years of Miner's Haven by crafting the new limited Enchanted item, Dreamer's Birthday Cake!

events.name: Easter 2024
events.summary: The sixth annual Easter event has arrived in Miner's Haven! Collect eggs around The Haven and Easter Island to earn yourself a reward! This event features a new limited-time Reborn, the Carrot Village.

events.name: St. Patrick's Day 2024
events.summary: St. Patrick's Day has arrived in Miner's Haven! Find yourself scavenging through the map for Magic Clovers to earn yourself a reward. This event features 7 new items including a new limited time reborn, the Lepretron.

events.name: Valentine's Day 2024
events.summary: Valentine's Day has arrived in Miner's Haven! Treat yourselves with various returning items, including limited collectibles and unboxable exotics, and a new limited-time Valentine's Day Reborn-Tier Upgrader, the Rose Palace.

events.name: Winter 2023
events.summary: As with every December, it's that time of year when the dandruff in the sky rains all over the haven, otherwise known as snow.

events.name: Black Friday 2023
events.summary: The eighth annual Black Friday sale to Miner's Haven began on November 24 2023 at 1:12 PM EST and Ended on November 27 2023 at 1:00 PM EST

events.name: Halloween 2023
events.summary: The Halloween event has returned! This year's event is a rerun; unlike 2022/2021, it did not feature the Four Horsemen of the Apocalypse quest.

events.name: 8th Birthday
events.summary: Miner's Haven, released on June 12, 2015, is currently celebrating its eighth anniversary on June 13, 2023. This is the sixth birthday update.

events.name: Easter 2023
events.summary: The fifth Easter event has started, bringing past Eggxotics with 5 new eggs to collect and returning Exotics!

events.name: St. Patrick's Day 2023
events.summary: The Saint Patrick's Day event has returned as the blue moon shines upon the lands, bestowing you all with one final opportunity to procure a Golden Clover Blaster, Pot of Gold and Clover Shrine.

events.name: Halloween 2022
events.summary: The Halloween event has returned! This year's event is a rerun, similar to 2021 minor adjustments were made to make event progression easier. This event has 4 parts, corresponding to the Four Horsemen of the Apocalypse (Plague, War, Famine, and Conquest).

events.name: 7th Birthday
events.summary: Miner's Haven's seventh birthday re-ran the previous year's birthday event.

events.name: Winter 2021
events.summary: The Christmas event has arrived in Miner's Haven on December 3rd. You'll be producing gifts for Santa with special snowflake-marked items. In exchange, you'll receive rare presents that will unwrap into items! Jak'uhfdor will give you the essentials, she can be found over by the giant Christmas tree with Santa.

events.name: Black Friday 2021
events.summary: The sixth annual Black Friday sale to Miner's Haven began on 26 November, 2021 and ended on 28 November, 2021.

events.name: Halloween 2021
events.summary: Miner's Haven seventh annual Halloween event was launched on October 5th. This event has 4 parts, corresponding to the Four Horsemen of the Apocalypse (Plague, War, Famine, and Conquest).

events.name: 6th Birthday
events.summary: Miner's Haven, released on June 12, 2015, celebrated its sixth anniversary on June 12, 2021. This is the fifth anniversary update (2019 had no such celebration due to Miner's Haven's hiatus status at the time).

events.name: Metaverse / Easter 2021
events.summary: All new eggs in this year's egg hunt, with the exception of the Baby Borker Egg and the Leggacy, spawn in Easter Island. Old eggs (from the previous year's Easter event) spawn only in the Haven. A list of old eggs can be found on this page.

events.name: Spring 2021
events.summary: The Miner's Haven Spring update, launched on 28 February, 2021. With snow melting, and the grass appearing, marking the end of Winter and the start of the new season, Spring!

events.name: Valentine's Day 2021
events.summary: The Valentine's Event 2021 is an event that began on 13 February, 2021 and ended on 27 February, 2021. This update is the second Miner's Haven event in 2021. It added various items, including limited collectibles and unboxable exotics, and a limited-time Valentine's Day Reborn-Tier Upgrader, the Wedding Cake.

events.name: 2021 Countdown
events.summary: The New Years 2021 Event is an event that takes place from 31/12/2020 to 04/1/2021, it includes a bunch of New Years Themed items.

events.name: Winter 2020
events.summary: Miner's Haven's 2020 Christmas Event started off the month, on December 4, reintroducing the Advent Calendar along with a new Winter-themed map and soundtrack. It ended on January 3, 2021.

events.name: Black Friday 2020
events.summary: The fifth annual Black Friday sale to Miner's Haven began on 27 November 2020 at 2:30 EST and ended on 30 November at 0:26 EST.

events.name: Halloween 2020
events.summary: Miner's Haven's eleventh major content update of 2020, and the sixth annual Halloween event was launched on October 6th. This event had 4 parts, Corresponding to the Four Horsemen of the Apocalypse (Plague, War, Famine, and Conquest).

events.name: Fifth Anniversary Event
events.summary: Miner's Haven, released on June 12, 2015, celebrated its fifth anniversary on June 12, 2020. This is the seventh major update released in 2020, as well as the fourth birthday event (2019 had no such celebration due to Miner's Haven's hiatus status at the time).

events.name: Easter 2020
events.summary: The fourth Miner's Haven content update of 2020 and the third Easter event for the game commenced on April 12 and ended on April 21.

events.name: St. Patrick's Day 2020
events.summary: Miner's Haven's third St. Patrick's Day event ran from March 15th to March 31st. It is known as the second major update/event to be released in Miners Haven in 2020.

events.name: Valentine's Day 2020
events.summary: Miner's Haven's first major update/event of 2020 began on Monday, February 10th, 2020 at 5:00 UTC. It concluded with the release of the 2020 St. Patrick's Event, which began on March 15th at 7:00PM EST.

events.name: 2020 Countdown
events.summary: The tenth and final Miner's Haven update/event of 2019, titled the "2020 Countdown", commenced on December 31st, 2019 at 3AM EST and ending on January 2nd, 2020.

events.name: Winter 2019
events.summary: Miner's Haven's fourth Holiday event began on December 1st, 2019.

events.name: Black Friday 2019
events.summary: Miner's Haven's fifth annual Black Friday event began on November 29, 2019 at 12:00AM EST.

events.name: 1 Million Favorites!
events.summary: Miner's Haven reached 1 Million favorites on November 1st, 2019. OutOfOrderFoxy released a celebratory event the next day that ran alongside the Halloween Event.

events.name: Halloween 2019
events.summary: Miner's Haven's fifth annual Halloween event, officially titled "Barons Spookening", was launched on October 26th, 2019. The event concluded on November 8th, 2019.

events.name: Pizza Party
events.summary: Miner's Haven's first major update and event of 2019, officially titled "Pizza Party", was launched on March 19th, 2019. The event concluded on April 2nd, 2019.

events.name: Black Friday 2018
events.summary: The fourth annual Black Friday Event began on November 23, 2018. Unlike prior Black Fridays, this year has no exclusive artifacts. Instead, the event hosts discounts off of select Miner's Haven gamepasses. Fire sales of certain products were slated to occur, but never happened.

events.name: Halloween 2018
events.summary: The fourth annual Halloween Event for Miner's Haven began on October 29th, 2018 and ended on December 20th, 2018. The update introduced 5 new items as well as the return of Pumpkin Boxes and a map re-skin.

events.name: The Gargantuan Update
events.summary: The 2018 Summer Update, officially titled The Gargantuan Update, also known as the 2018 Birthday Event and Miner's Haven 3rd Anniversary, was an update released on June 11th, 2018, designed to celebrate Miner's Haven official release to public on June 12th, 2015.

events.name: 100 Million Visits!
events.summary: The 100 Million Visits Event was a Miner's Haven event commemorating 100 million visits to Miner's Haven. The event was launched on April 15th, 2018 and ended on April 28th, 2018. The festivities include new items, item buffs and an abridged second Exotic "Day".

events.name: Magic Clover Event
events.summary: The Magic Clover Event, also known as the 2018 St. Patrick's Event, is an event in Miner's Haven that was released on St. Patrick's Day 2018. It is the second annual St. Patrick's Event in Miner's Haven after the Golden Clover Event.

events.name: Innovation: Black Panther
events.summary: The 2018 Innovation Event was an event in Miner's Haven. It showcased the return of The Innovator and hosted two brand new quests-- both of them awarded exclusive avatar items. The event launched on February 5th (7:20A PST) and ended on February 18th (7:03P PST).

events.name: Fresh Air Update
events.summary: The Fresh Air update is the first update for Miner's Haven to be released in 2018. This update marks the end of the 2017 Winter Event. Here are more/in-depth details of the update besides the official changelog.

events.name: Winter 2017
events.summary: The 2017 Winter Event is an event in Miner's Haven that took off on December 17th, 2017 and ended on January 19th, 2018. The initial update saw the release of holiday-themed items, a seasonal box containing festive items from years past, and the revelation of Part I of the Black Friday Artifacts bought in 2017.

events.name: Black Friday 2017
events.summary: The 2017 Black Friday Update is a patch for Miner's Haven that was released on November 24th, 2017 which was on time for Black Friday 2017 despite releasing the 2017 Spooky Update in late October 2017.

events.name: Halloween 2017
events.summary: The third annual Halloween Event began with Part I on 24 October 2017. This update introduced a new limited-edition box, new items, as well as the return of the Headless Horseman. This is the third annual Halloween event, following 2015 and 2016.

events.name: 2nd Birthday
events.summary: The Birthday Update 2017 is a Miner's Haven update that occurred on June 12th, 2017 and lasted until July 11th, 2017.

events.name: Summer 2017
events.summary: The 2017 Summer Update was a large update to Miner's Haven, with Part 1 being released on May 28, 2017. Part 1 brought along with a new summer-themed map and officially concluded Exotic Day, while the highlight of this update was the long-anticipated return of PvP, this time with a heavy emphasis on melee and removal of spawn-camping and RP-Stealing.

events.name: Exotic Day
events.summary: Exotic Day was an event that ran from May 27 (3:35 PM EST, 12:35 PM PST) to the official launch of the 2017 Summer Update on May 28 (approx. 8:15 PM EST). During the event, every Exotic that had been in Mystery

events.name: Clan Contest
events.summary: The Clan Contest was the first in-game contest that began which took place from April 19th 2017 to May 15th 2017. Berezaa details the event on bergames.com. ROBLOX Clans would compete to farm the most research points and the winning clan would collaborative on a in-game decoration to represent their group.

events.name: Easter 2017
events.summary: 2017 was the first year that Miner's Haven held an Easter event. This is the second update that Berezaa posted patch notes at bergames.com. Since Berezaa

events.name: Pre Easter Update 2017
events.summary: Around this time, Berezaa had a steady pace of releasing updates for Miner's Haven. On March 31st, 2017, berezaa released the Skipped Life Update and released the 2017 Easter Event on April 15th, 2017.

events.name: Golden Clover Event
events.summary: The St. Patrick's Day Event 2017 was first announced on March 17, 2017, and was released on the same day at 5:00pm EST (contrary to Berezaa stating 5:30pm EST). A new NPC was added along with The Innovator, The Leprechaun (referred to as "Patty" in the game). He or she sells some of the new items.

events.name: New Year's 2017
events.summary: This update was released on January 20th, 2017 around 12:15pm EST. Originally scheduled for release on morning, it was delayed for 6 more hours for unknown reason, but

events.name: Winter 2016
events.summary: The 2016 MH WInter Update featured a variety of new items and features just in time for the seasons. Users also received perks after buying artifacts during Black Friday 2016 and the event was released as parts.

events.name: Black Friday 2016
events.summary: The second annual Black Friday event for Miner's Haven took place on November 25th 2016. It kicked off on Friday morning when Berezaa released the sale of a variety of passes, which are listed below.

events.name: Halloween 2016
events.summary: The second annual Halloween Event for Miner's Haven ran through October 14th, 2016 to November 4th. The event came in three parts; the first establishing the halloween theme and the second introduced the smash-able pumpkins. The third part introduced the limited-time Reborn item Blood Magic as well as giant pumpkins.

events.name: Fourth of July Update
events.summary: This update was released on the night of July 4th, 2016.

events.name: Birthday Update
events.summary: This is a page related to Miner's Haven anniversaries to come! This page was created on 12th June, 2016 in observance of Miner's haven's first birthday which featured a new map.

events.name: The Outdoors Update
events.summary: Continuing the commitment Berezaa had with Miner's Haven in April 2016, Berezaa released a variety of new items and content for Miner's Haven in May 2016.

events.name: Winter Event 2015
events.summary: The Miner's Haven Winter Update, also commonly know as the Winter Event, Christmas Event, Christmas Update, or the Secret Update, as Berezaa called it, was the second event to occur in Miner's Haven. This event had four different parts to it as shown below.

events.name: Black Friday 2015
events.summary: The 2015 Black Friday event was the first Black Friday event in Miner's Haven. On Black Friday, Berezaa released three artifacts (thus introducing artifacts) which would only be on sale that day. Players knew that they would give perks of some sort but they wouldn't know what kind they would receive.

events.name: Halloween 2015
events.summary: The 2015 Spooky Update is the very first limited time event in Miner's Haven, with a new map, lighting, and seasonal GUIs. The updated was originally planned for Friday, 9 October 2015, but was pushed back to the next day. This update also introduced new item tiers, including the Exotic and Collectible tiers.

events.name: Summer 2015
events.summary: The Summer Update 2015 was released on July 7, 2015. It was considered the first major update since Miner's Haven's release, introducing mostly Shop items designated for late-game.
